h1: Custom Reflective Lanyards for Safety and Visibility
metaDescription: Order custom reflective lanyards for high-visibility branding. Perfect for safety teams, events, and night operations at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Reflective lanyards combine practical safety with brand visibility, making them an ideal choice for construction sites, parking lot attendants, or evening events. The 3/4" reflective tape on these lanyards catches light from headlights or flashlights, ensuring your staff stays visible in low-light conditions. Custom imprint your logo or company name for a professional look that also enhances workplace safety.
heroAltText: Custom reflective lanyards with high-visibility tape and plastic clamshell attachment, ideal for safety and branding.
